scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @mapos/api" "npm run dev -w @mapos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mapos/layer-sdk && npm run build -w @mapos/api && npm run build -w @mapos/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mapos/layer-sdk && npm run test -w @mapos/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mapos/layer-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @mapos/api && npm run typecheck -w @mapos/web
